name: echo-loop
description: Echo Loop: a neon synthwave lane runner where your best run races you as an echo.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
